answer: Because the signal nonce is published only after close, the juniper audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. The three words are derived from a 157 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate glacier derivation per key. That is 26 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
